Chapter 6534: Mountains Of Corpses

Chapter 6534: Mountains of Corpses

The small number of cicadas only decreased with more adventurers. Heaven-slayers and primal ancestors paid extremely high prices for them.

Thus, people came either for wealth or a longer life. However, supreme overlords didn’t want them since Supreme Black Ancestor had analyzed the situation.

He warned the world that this so-called life prolongment was mere puppetry. This didn’t lower the temptation for weaker cultivators.

The place had plenty of mountains but not a single blade of grass. Cemeteries scattered across the land and appeared to be naturally formed.

Portals manifested into reality and Cosmic Surge stepped out, preparing formations to create a grand momentum.

“They want to destroy everything.” Powerful spectators observed the event with their heavenly gaze.

“It’s a suppression, no corpses will appear there again.” A desolate god said.

“That’s a good thing, destroy this unholy land.” One big shot murmured.

“If Xian Chengtian is right, Bao Pu’s presence might be the reason for the land’s forbidden nature.” An emperor said.

No one understood why corpses gathered in this remote region and buried themselves here. Perhaps it had something to do with Bao Pu’s terrible techniques now that he had turned evil.

“Rumble!” The land cracked from the formations and dreadful death energy oozed outward, forming a miasma capable of turning the living into the dead.

Corpses also appeared from the mountains and cracks, roaring ferociously. They became abundant like fish in rivers. They were empowered and were as tough as steel.

The tsunami of corpses and their miasma corroded everything into a foul sludge along the way.

“This horde of death will bring untold destruction in our world.” A desolate god said.

“Phoenix Formation.” Skyfire Phoenix ordered and the legion became as one, plowing forward against the incoming horde.

They brimmed with divinity and were protected by an immortal dao, nullifying the miasma.

The tough corpses couldn’t handle their march and were trampled to pieces.

“So strong!” Spectators were amazed to see this.

Alas, more corpses appeared everywhere, breaking through the earth and mountains.

“How can there be so many corpses?” Someone said.

“Maybe the remnants of the old world.” An elder ancestor said because some of the corpses wore archaic clothes.

“Don’t tell me... Bao Pu might have secretly refined a continent’s inhabitants into corpses.” A progenitor speculated.

Eventually, more powerful corpses appeared. A figure broke through a peak with the shape of a tomb.

“Boom!” He released a surge of mystical energy like a celestial eagle spreading its wings.

This valiant man radiated divine power with the image of a magnificent eagle flying behind him.

“Firmament Eagle Monarch!” Some recognized him.
